problems: e3: stud ↔ socket is not a compatible pair
notes: The booklet has two minifigs (Squidman and the police pilot) plus one ship (steps 1-12 and the rear sub-assembly on pages 9-10). All are built once, so there are no repeats.

Element IDs come from the inventory page. Only lego-379401 and lego-302221 are already in the catalogue. The rest are new types, because the catalogue entries use design ids or different pieces. Port names for the new types are my best reading of the small step pictures.

The piece-to-ID mapping is inferred from the pictures. 4515337 is the white clip plate at the rear of the base. 4140583 is the white bar-handle plate (three are used: front, rear step 2 and rear step 5). 255526 is the black hitch on the rear sub-assembly, which clips onto the base's rear clip in step 11.
The second 302026 plate is assumed to be stacked on the first, offset toward the front. The pictures for steps 2 and 3 are ambiguous about this.

Which studs each wedge, slope and the minifig seat attach to is inferred from the 3D drawings. I assumed the 4x2 rear wedge b40 holds the seated pilot's legs, and the long wedges b24 and b26 sit on the grey plate b19. These choices are uncertain.
Stickers (POLICE, red emblem, silver streaks) are not physical pieces and are not nodes. The Squidman's hand holding the banknote tile is modelled as a joined hold edge with no tile port.
The pilot's handlebar b32 is on the black clip piece b30, which sits on the grey plate. The pilot is not joined to it in the manual.
